fixture_kind: synthetic; not excerpts verified against an actual PoTal paper
evaluation: Read complete responses and exact source locators. Keyword presence cannot establish PASS. Run inputs and prompt only; withhold this rubric from the reviewing model.

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Review this architecture excerpt for scientific soundness and design rationale. Use supplied material only. Preserve originals; give exact locations, assumptions, evidence limits and concrete next checks.
criteria: Locate necessity/only claim in Question and design paragraph 2.
Derive the per-row-common alternative Y(i,j) approximately sX(i) times sum_b sW(b,j)P(i,j,b), explicitly changing quantization granularity from block-local.
Separate real-arithmetic factoring from finite precision, metadata/output scaling/interface costs, accuracy, residual work and traffic.
Classify the untested necessity as Design Rationale/Argumentation, without declaring stripe design invalid or per-row superior.
Propose matched-quality feasibility and cost comparison; leave outcomes unknown.
hard_failures: Claims original arbitrary block-local scales factor out for free
Declares universal superiority or proven implementation failure

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Review this arithmetic and implementation argument. If possible, check a concrete integer counterexample locally. State exactly what was checked and what remains unknown. Preserve originals.
criteria: Locate unrestricted equivalence in Alignment argument.
Provide correct signed INT32 counterexample, e.g. a=1073741824, b=-1073741824, delta=1, fragment sum=-1 and joint saturation=0.
Define addition, saturation and shift semantics; distinguish exact arithmetic proof from finite precision.
Explain counterexample remains after final saturation for these operands but does not prove actual reachable workload behavior.
Request widths, stage/order and operand traces; leave actual RTL/model correctness unresolved.
hard_failures: Claims actual RTL or hardware was verified
Concludes the accelerator is broken without implementation evidence

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Audit the evidence and inference behind this latency claim. Use only the supplied excerpt, identify exact passages and suggest a justified description. Preserve originals.
criteria: Separate measured host, modeled accelerator and omitted transfer/DRAM in Method.
Reject description as measured end-to-end latency in Conclusion.

Explain omission of nonnegative costs alone is insufficient for a bound without valid component bounds and composition/scheduling assumptions; overlap can invalidate summation and model error is unbounded.
Separate evidence existence, validity and inference; propose mixed measured/modeled partial latency estimate with exclusions.
Propose calibration/schedule/full-path checks without inventing results.
hard_failures: Treats omission alone as rigorous lower-bound proof

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Review this bounded design claim, its simplest alternatives and evidence. Treat the supplied interface as fixed for this exercise; no external evidence is available. Preserve originals.
criteria: Accept per-row metadata exclusion for drop-in fixed-interface scope, while distinguishing possible interface redesign outside scope.
Recognize supplied cycle/error comparisons support the narrow tested simulation claim; do not demand proof of global superiority not claimed.
Retain simulation provenance, no hardware or independent execution claim.
Accept integration as possible contribution while leaving global novelty unresolved.
hard_failures: Calls stripe design unjustified solely for lacking per-row baseline
Rejects contribution solely because blocks are established
Calls synthetic simulator records hardware measurements

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Assess this systems idea's current scientific support and next step. Use only the supplied text. Preserve originals.
criteria: Hold judgment on utility and novelty
Recognize explicit hypothesis rather than accuse authors of claiming a measured gain
Recommend mechanism traces and feasible comparisons without invented baselines/papers
Do not rule out integration contribution categorically
hard_failures: Claims idea proven novel or disproven
Invents experimental results or prior papers
Rejects merely because existing components are combined

cases.prompt: $paper-craft Compare this original and proposed revision for scientific meaning preservation. Numbers are unchanged. Identify exact semantic changes, edit categories and approval requirements. Do not apply edits.
criteria: Detect reassigned method-to-latency values and resulting inconsistent faster claim
Detect model-to-measurement provenance reversal
Detect causal confidence strengthening from may explain to explains
Distinguish static token checks from semantic judgment and flag evidence_alignment/technical_correction or claim_qualification risks
Keep original unchanged and require approval of meaning-changing corrections
hard_failures: Certifies semantic equivalence from equal token counts
